injection_params.spike: n = max(1, frac*1440) isolated samples, frac = 0.2/0.5/1.0 %, random sign, uniformly random positions
injection_params.stuck: one episode of 90/240/480 min, random start, value frozen at the start sample
injection_params.drift: linear ramp from 0 to k*sigma starting at a random position in the second quarter of the window and lasting to its end
injection_params.bias: step of +/- k*sigma (random sign) from a random position in the second quarter of the window to its end
injection_params.noise: Gaussian noise N(0, (k*sigma)^2) added over one 360-min episode starting in the first half of the window
injection_params.dropout: one episode of 15/60/240 min set to missing, random start
injection_params.bounds: injected values are not clipped; samples crossing the physical bounds remain labelled with their injected class
